title: PrefPalette: Personalized Preference Modeling with Latent Attributes

bias_targets.methodology: Addressed by substituting explicit, self-reported preference annotations (which are prone to response bias) with unobtrusive, in-the-wild behavioral signals (Reddit upvotes and downvotes) to capture actual human preferences.

Evaluated by measuring preference prediction accuracy across 45 diverse online communities using 10 Schwartz cultural value dimensions (e.g., hedonism, tradition, achievement) to demonstrate how monolithic models fail to capture community-specific values.

Evaluated by analyzing how different online communities dynamically weight 9 sociolinguistic norms (e.g., verbosity, sarcasm, directness, supportiveness) to highlight the limitations of aggregate preference models in diverse communication contexts.
